D., & Mungall, C. J. 2014. Global Biotic Interactions: An open infrastructure to share and analyze species-interaction datasets. Ecological Informatics 24:148-159. DOI: 10.1016/j.ecoinf.2014.08.005. GloBI also recommends citing original indexed data contributors when row-level references are available.
